{{Quote|We believe that the Queen of the Red has been led by deceit into allying herself with Nuso Esva.''"<br />"''Impossible. The Queen is all-knowing and capable of infinite depth of thought. No alien being could sway her mind to such an extent.|Jirvin and Trevik|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Queen of the Red''' was the [[Queen of the Red|ruler]] of the [[Quesoth]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. She entered into an alliance with the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] but was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by him as the [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Attack on the Red City|fought]] to liberate her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
